title: Calc chains bound b at the min and max of a for EGMO 2023 P1
intent: Reduce the goal ∀ i j, a i = a j to the single fact ∀ i, b i = 2 by bounding b from below at a minimum index m of a (b m ≥ 2) and from above at a maximum index M (b M ≤ 2), each bound a two-link calc chain, then closing by antisymmetry (eq_of_le_of_ge).

parent.name: egmo2023_p1
parent.statement:
problem egmo2023_p1 (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (_ : n ≥ 3) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ∀ i, a i > 0)
    (b : Fin n → ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, b i = (a (i - 1) + a (i + 1)) / (a i))
    (h : ∀ i j, a i ≤ a j ↔ b i ≤ b j) : ∀ i j, a i = a j

children.name: h1
children.closed_by: calc: b m ≥ (a m + a m)/(a m) by rw [hb m]; gcongr (closing a m ≤ a m, a m ≤ a (m - 1), a m ≤ a (m + 1) from hm); then _ ≥ 2 by rw [← two_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀]; positivity [ha m]

children.name: h2
children.closed_by: calc: b M ≤ (a M + a M)/(a M) by rw [hb M]; gcongr (closing a (M - 1) ≤ a M, a (M + 1) ≤ a M from hM); then _ ≤ 2 by rw [← two_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀]; positivity [ha M]

applicability.goal_shape: an inequality E ≥ c or E ≤ c over an ordered ring, where E expands to a ratio or sum that can first be bounded by a simpler expression through monotonicity (gcongr) and then reduced to a constant by rewriting plus positivity/norm_num
applicability.use_when: the target bound factors into a monotonicity link (replace each argument by its min/max or a known ≤/≥ fact) followed by an exact algebra link (rw to a numeral); the two bounds are symmetric so one chain template serves both; the enclosing proof closes the two bounds by antisymmetry
applicability.avoid_when: a link is not monotone in its arguments so gcongr cannot close it; a link needs its own substantial proof rather than a one-tactic block (then state it as a separate lemma); the chain is long with each link a real lemma; the bounds are strict (<) and the exactness of the constant matters

claims.claim: Each child is a calc chain of exactly two inequality links — h1 : b m ≥ (a m + a m)/(a m) ≥ 2 and h2 : b M ≤ (a M + a M)/(a M) ≤ 2 — and each link closes with one tactic block (gcongr, then rw + positivity), with no auxiliary lemma.

claims.claim: The parent egmo2023_p1 closes from the two bounds: h3 : ∀ i, b i = 2 is derived by apply eq_of_le_of_ge from h2 and h1 (lines 55-59), and the goal ∀ i j, a i = a j then closes by apply eq_of_le_of_ge and rewriting with h and h3 (lines 60-63).

consequences: Each calc chain creates one obligation per link, and transitivity of ≥/≤ is discharged by the chain itself (Lean's calc composes ≥ as well as ≤). Every link must be a one-tactic block: the monotonicity link relies on gcongr finding the ≤/≥ facts from the min/max hypotheses hm/hM, and the algebra link relies on rw [← two_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀] plus positivity [ha i] needing a i > 0. The final close (eq_of_le_of_ge) needs both directions: a lower bound b m ≥ 2 and an upper bound b M ≤ 2; supplying only one side leaves ∀ i, b i = 2 unproved.
